sourceProcedure.text: Wisdom is the class ability. Choose Elemental Affinity automatically at 1: Fire, Ice, Air or Earth. Spellcasting/RP remain separate from Totem objects and flasks. Totem capacity 1, rises 2 at 13; any third replaces one of your existing totems. A totem is a visible Tiny magical object: AC 12+PB, HP 2 L, immobile, immune to poison/psychic/conditions, vulnerable to ordinary weapon and other damage. At 0 HP its aura ends. A new totem appears within 30 ft; cannot occupy a creature's space, serve as a bridge, trap a creature without a save or move through walls.

sourceProcedure.text: Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

sourceProcedure.text: Bloodcaller at Hero 10 transforms permanently into Hagraven, with the player choosing this class path and its stated loss of ordinary Shaman spellcasting. It does NOT lose its RP reservoir: printed Hagraven/Totem techniques still pay RP, but it cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced magical flasks. It retains prior totem/technique selections. The change is a class choice, not permission for involuntary player-character conversion; ancestry identity and player control remain. At long rest it can prepare mundane flasks only if Base Flask Use is known.

sourceProcedure.effect: Create one Scrapling AC 12 HP L Speed 20 ft, commanded melee attack PB+INT for 1d6 bludgeoning. Counts as deployable slot/shared command. Consumed debris cannot be salvaged again; cannot spawn its own replacement.

sourceProcedure.name: Mech Overdrive
sourceProcedure.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
sourceProcedure.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.
